about.title: About GrindBuddy
about.p1: GrindBuddy was born from a simple frustration: every year, millions of entrepreneurs, student founders, and independent developers abandon promising projects — not because the ideas lack value, but because they lack structure, the right co-builders, and access to the right tools at the right time.
about.p2: We decided to remove those obstacles by creating a single platform that combines intelligent collaboration, artificial intelligence, and an integrated ecosystem of tools — all built for execution.
about.missionText: Democratize access to tools, mentorship, and collaboration for every digital builder.
about.visionText: A world where execution becomes the default outcome, not the exception.
about.impactText: Direct support for 3 UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 8, 9, 13).

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about GrindBuddy

items.a: Our system uses machine learning to analyze the skills, work style, availability, and goals of each builder. It then recommends the most compatible co-builders based on true fit, not just network proximity.

items.q: What tools are included in the marketplace?
items.a: Our marketplace includes 50+ verified tools for development, design, marketing, and analytics. We keep adding more and bringing in specialized AI agents.
GrindBuddy is free to start (3 projects, basic matching). The Pro plan at $19/month unlocks unlimited projects, full AI, and 20 integrations. Teams pay $39/month per seat with advanced analytics.
Yes. We use industry standards (OAuth 2.0, JWT, SSL/TLS encryption). For Enterprise customers we offer SSO, uptime SLAs, and full GDPR compliance.

items.q: Can I use GrindBuddy for my existing team?
items.a: Absolutely. Our Team and Enterprise plans are designed for small teams (3-10 people) and larger organizations. You get team analytics, shared workspaces, and dedicated support.
Yes. GrindBuddy supports full export of your projects, teams, and activity history. You retain 100% ownership of your data.

items.q: When will the mobile app be available?
items.a: The iOS and Android mobile apps are planned for Q4 2026. For now, the web version is fully optimized for mobile.

items.q: Do you offer a free trial?
items.a: Yes! The Free plan gives you unlimited access to all core features. No credit card required to get started.
